study.scope: Actual native forest-owned instance matrix, colour and coverage ArrayBuffers traced at WebGL bufferData/bufferSubData, real transfers with draw/raster calls suppressed. 120-step walking/turning path, first frame excluded after a full warm loop. Includes shadow/planar-capture forest uploads; excludes other scene buffers, texture uploads and GPU draw cost. Separate from CPU timing; not whole-scene traffic or hardware timing.
